main.description: A menu as seen at a point in time. Menus are posts, not rows: authored, dated, and immutable. They are never edited — a changed menu is a new record, so history is free. Authority comes from the signing repo, not from a field: a menu in a venue's own repo is that venue's menu; one in a patron's repo is a sighting. The app view prefers the venue's own and otherwise takes consensus across sightings.

title.description: What the menu calls itself, e.g. `Winter Cocktails`.

publishedAt.description: When this menu was published or observed.

validUntil.description: For seasonal menus or one-night lists. Absent means open-ended.

capture.description: Present on a patron's sighting, absent on a venue's own publication.

description.description: The menu's own words. Kept verbatim: it is the best signal for matching a house name to a flavour profile.

capture.description: How a sighting was obtained. A menu observed by a patron is evidence, not fact — several independent sightings are what make the app view confident.

confidence.description: 0-100. How much the parser trusts its own reading.
